entries.name: Clever Girls
entries.description: The anoles of Naked Rock have ventured forth from their territory to hunt. Eliminate the pack before they begin feeding on the smallfolk!

entries.name: One Enchanted Eve
entries.description: Some foul sorceress has enchanted the forest's funguars, transforming them into man-eating menaces!

entries.name: Sprig Cleaning
entries.description: Ever in search of scrumptious stones, a pack of spriggans has descended into the forest. Join the Wood Wailers to send the scamps back whence they came!

entries.name: Something in the Water
entries.description: Aetherial corruption has rendered one of the forest's water sprites extremely violent. Slay the creature before it harms the smallfolk!

entries.name: The Sting
entries.description: Aggressive hornet swarms nesting near Lilystone are preventing the smallfolk from tending to their daily tasks. Exterminate the pests and bring peace to the area!

entries.name: Asipatra Attacks
entries.description: Once believed only a creature of legend, the terrible winged Asipatra has been spotted in the Twelveswood. Slay the monster before he can claim any victims.

entries.name: Leader of the Pack
entries.description: A new alpha male has emerged within the local pack of anoles, emboldening the lesser beasts. The leader must be slain before the pack grows even more deadly.

entries.name: A Mother Scorned
entries.description: After losing several of their hoglets to the Trappers' League, massive wild sows have become overtaken with rage, gouging anything and everything that moves. To ensure the area's safety, the beasts must be put down.

entries.name: Alux of the Draw
entries.description: A markedly mischievous monster known as Alux has been spotted hiding in Spirithold. Ambush the voidsent, and slay him before he can escape.

entries.name: Lethe on My Mind
entries.description: The Matron's Lethe serves as an important thoroughfare for merchants and travelers, and to ensure they arrive safely at their destinations, the area must be kept clear of deadly predators.

entries.name: Training Day
entries.description: Assist the new recruit to the Order of the Twin Adder who has found himself outmatched in a training exercise with his commanding officer, Miraudont the Madder.

entries.name: Bleeding Green
entries.description: Help prevent the spread of leafbleed─a sickness causing the death of local foliage─by slaying Matagaigai, an overgrown landtrap known to carry the bane.

entries.name: Tastes Like Chick
entries.description: Several chocobo chicks have escaped from Bentbranch Meadows and now are in danger of being eaten by carnivorous tree slugs. Defeat the slugs before they can fill their bellies!

entries.name: Sleep Tight
entries.description: Someone or something has awakened souls laid to rest long ago in the Tam-Tara Deepcroft, and now the restless revenants seek blood!

entries.name: Spirithold Run
entries.description: A cadre of Spirithold-dwelling imps is planning a mass exodus into the Twelveswood to make their merry mischief. Trap them in the abandoned dungeon and see that they never leave.

entries.name: Love Is in the Air
entries.description: Scores of diremites have crawled from their nest holes and gathered near Galvanth's Spire to search for mates. Join forces with the local Wood Wailer guard and see that the vilekin die spouseless.

entries.name: There's Something about Lou
entries.description: A giant slug known by the playful moniker Lou Carcolh has been seen near the Guardian Tree. Slay the beast before he consumes the sacred monument.

entries.name: Now I See Bees I Won
entries.description: Honey-seeking imps are killing off peaceful bees, and if the malevolent monsters are not stopped soon, honey production in the Twelveswood could suffer a serious blow.

entries.name: Royal Rumble
entries.description: The Prince of Pestilence has been spotted spreading corruption in the area. Slay His Royal Repugnance.

entries.name: 戦場までは何マルム？
entries.description:
暗黙の境界線をまたぎ
侵入してきた帝国兵を追い散らすのだ
IIIコホルス・ベスティアリウスを倒せ

entries.name: What a Bee Wants
entries.description: Tree slugs have descended from their arboreal abodes to feed on the forest's flowers...much to the chagrin of the region's beekeepers, who understand no flowers means no honey.

entries.name: Stopping the Spread
entries.description: Swift-breeding, disease-carrying gnats threaten to disrupt the balance of nature in the Twelveswood. Slay the vile voidsent before their numbers multiply.

entries.name: Jack of All Trades
entries.description: The Jackanapes and his rowdy troop are defiling the forest as they roam in search of new territory. Slay the leader of the pack before he can do any further damage.

entries.name: リトルブリッジの戦い
entries.description:
ラムウの狂信者と化したシルフたちが
ラークスコール方面に押し寄せてきた
吊り橋に陣取り、シルフを倒せ

entries.name: Protecting the Patch
entries.description: Diseased treants were recently seen wandering through the Bramble Patch. Put the poor creatures out of their misery before the infection spreads to the healthy flora.

entries.name: The Hunted
entries.description: Sirocco, a giant antelope long sought after by the Trappers' League, has been sighted in the area. Fame and fortune await those who can claim this trophy.

entries.name: Eft for Dead
entries.description: Black efts from the east have begun taking over Rootslake, forcing out other species native to the area. Help cull their population before it's too late.

entries.name: The Negotiators
entries.description: Negotiations between goblin merchants and a gang of local poachers have turned sour. Use this opportunity to teach both bands of outlaws a lesson!

entries.name: Breaching the Hive
entries.description: Infiltrate Redbelly Hive by defeating the gatewatches and opening the gates.

entries.name: Clearing the Hive
entries.description: Make haste to the heart of Redbelly Hive and defeat the bandit leader Severaint Seven Splinter.

entries.name: Defending the Hive
entries.description: Join forces with the Wood Wailers to defend Redbelly Hive from the bandits who seek to reclaim it.

entries.name: Keeping the Hive
entries.description: Defend Redbelly Hive while demoralizing the remaining Redbellies by slaying their larceners.

entries.name: Kickin' It with the Kedtraps
entries.description: The Upper Paths have become tangled with kedtraps. Slice your way through the seedkin before they choke the life from the forest.

entries.name: The Coeurl King
entries.description: A band of Miqo'te poachers has begun hunting in the Twelveswood, led by a solitary male who has crowned himself King of the Coeurlclaws. Slay the unholy sovereign and send his subjects scampering.

entries.name: Another Round
entries.description: One of Buscarron's Druthers' more unruly patrons─Spenser of the Bottomless Cup─has (once again) had one too many mugs of mead, and begun fighting with another customer. Come and silence the sot.

entries.name: Stag Parting
entries.description: Something has normally placid antelope stags stirred into a frenzy. Put the poor beasts down before they injure themselves or others.

entries.name: Hide and Seek
entries.objective: Deliver the poached hides to the Wood Wailer.
entries.description: The Twelveswood has become a breeding ground for poachers. Slay the lawless fiends, retrieve the hides of their innocent victims, and deliver them to the Wood Wailer.

entries.name: A Tale of Two-tails
entries.description: The Sixth Astral Era airship landing ruins have been transformed by poachers into a black market. Seek out and slay their ringleader, Yabi Two-tails.

entries.name: To Whom the Toll Goes
entries.description: Footpads have set up illegal checkpoints along major roadways, and are forcefully collecting coin from any who attempt to pass. Seek out these ne'er-do-wells and show them crime doesn't pay.

entries.name: Eat In, Hide Out
entries.description: Redbelly bandits have made an abandoned homestead their hideout. Find their camp and slay the entire gang.

entries.name: Robbin' Goblins
entries.objective: Return the stolen crates to the crestfallen merchant.
entries.description: Goblin robbers have attacked a merchant en route to Gridania. Cut down the culprits and reclaim the lost crates!

entries.name: ※β1不要：ウォータースプライトの大量発生
entries.description: ※β1不要：

entries.name: No Birds Allowed
entries.description: Ixali scouts have been spotted near Treespeak. Locate the invaders and drive them from the forest...by any means necessary!

entries.name: Dschubba Snacks
entries.description: Every few moons, a miteling hatches that is several times more violent than his brethren. This creature is known by the local smallfolk as Dschubba. Slay the vilekin before it has the chance to reach adulthood.

entries.name: Now Fall
entries.description: A horde of banemites has been reported migrating towards Fallgourd Float. Slay the vilekin before they can reach the settlement located there.

entries.name: That Which Binds Us
entries.objective: Hand the golem fragments over to the shifty-eyed prospector.
entries.description: A local prospector believes that a high mineral content in the stones which make up golems may be what holds the creatures together, and will reward anyone who helps him prove his theory.

entries.name: 真理は死んだ
entries.description:
霊災前後から出没するようになった
ゴーレムたちを排除せよ
ストーンゴーレムを倒せ

entries.name: Breaking Bud
entries.description: Troublemaking opo-opos have expanded their territory slightly too close to Blessed Bud. Bloody their noses a bit to ensure they keep their distance.

entries.name: The Magical Fruit
entries.description: Opo-opos in search of Mun-Tuy beans have begun raiding Hyrstmill storehouses. Slay the beastkin and prevent any sacks of beans from being stolen.

entries.name: Micromanaging
entries.description: Curupira─an especially savage microchu─is on the loose and must be reduced to mulch, lest it be allowed to roam the forest freely, feeding on cuddly woodland creatures and Lalafellin children.

entries.name: The Big Issue
entries.description: A band of Ixali raiders has attacked a Wood Wailer caravan carrying supplies to outlying camps. Drive back the beastmen while ensuring they do not make off with any plunder.

entries.name: It Ziz What It Is
entries.description: Giant carnivorous scalekin known as ziz have wandered near Fallgourd Float in search of fresh meat. Slay the creatures before anyone becomes supper.

entries.name: Hare Today
entries.description: Shroud hares are devouring the young trees of Alder Springs. Throw a little salt into their plans before the damage is beyond repair.

entries.name: Where the Stone Rolls
entries.description: The masterless golem known as Nunyunuwi must be slain, lest it unwittingly crush some poor passerby.

entries.name: Attack on Highbridge: Prelude
entries.description: Qiqirn bandits have launched a surprise assault on Highbridge. Join forces with the remaining Brass Blades and defend the landmark with your lives!

entries.name: Attack on Highbridge: Act I
entries.description: Qiqirn bandits have launched a surprise assault on Highbridge. Fend off the attackers while ensuring the safety of the village residents and their supplies.

entries.name: Attack on Highbridge: Act II
entries.description: Qiqirn bandit leader Gilpincher Zuzuroon has joined the fray. Continue your efforts to fend off the attack while protecting the village residents and their supplies.

entries.name: Attack on Highbridge: Act III
entries.description: It turns out the Qiqirn bandits were hired by the Amalj'aa to kidnap Highbridge residents and deliver them to the Bowl of Embers for tempering. Slay the Amalj'aa leader Nayokk Roh and end this madness.

entries.name: Attack on Highbridge: Denouement
entries.description: Join the Brass Blades in rescuing the Highbridge residents kidnapped by the Qiqirn bandits and slay the mastermind behind this dark design─Nayokk Roh.

entries.name: Steel Reign
entries.description: Atop his mighty steed, clad in armor darker than the void, the elder primal Odin has returned to Eorzea to exact his brutal judgment upon the realm.

entries.name: Lady Killer
entries.description: Ladybugs are more than welcome to dine on the aphids which infest the orchards of the Central Shroud; however, some have acquired a taste for the honeybees who pollinate the crops. See that this meal is their last.

entries.name: My Baby Green
entries.description: An overgrown tangle of vivified vines lovingly named Jaded Jody is drinking up all the water of Hopeseed Pond. If action is not taken quickly, the whole area will be dry by the next moon.

entries.name: Ivy League
entries.description: Some species of ivy will continue growing until they have choked the life out of the entire forest. Assist both the Wood Wailers and the Gods' Quiver in their joint effort to clear the Twelveswood of this menace.

entries.name: Thunderstruck
entries.description: Sylphs tempered in the levin-light of the primal Ramuh have descended into Little Solace to abduct their untempered brethren. Protect the innocent by delivering lightning-swift justice to the perpetrators.

entries.name: Carrion Baggage
entries.description: Scraps of food left scattered along forest thoroughfares by goblin travelers are attracting all sorts of carrion-craving cloudkin, who, when the fodder is gone, set their sights on poor Lalafellin pilgrims. Discourage further vultures from frequenting the region by slaying the ones already here.

entries.name: Conspiracy Theory
entries.description: High-ranking members of the Redbelly Wasps have gathered in an abandoned hovel to discuss their next attack on Gridania's trade routes. See that they do not leave alive.

entries.name: Waiting for a Moon to Fall
entries.description: Remnants of Dalamud fallen from the celestial satellite have been reanimated by some sinister force, and now roam the region in the form of powerful golems. Destroy the soulkin before they wreak their havoc on the forest.

entries.name: What Have You Done for Mead Lately
entries.description: A divine rite is being planned at the Sanctum of the Twelve and the clergy require copious amounts of freshly brewed mead to...uh, purify their spirits. Escort the porter and see that the mead arrives safely.

entries.name: Lazy for You
entries.description: The things we love destroy us every time. So it was with Farmer Laurence, who was devoured by his grossly overgrown pet ochu which he named after himself. Slay the rampant creature, that the old farmer's soul might know peace.

entries.name: Menuis at Work
entries.description: The once-gentle aurochs living in the Cookpot have grown bold since the arrival of a bull known as Menuis. Slay the beast and show the other creatures who it is they should truly fear.

entries.name: Overnight Migration
entries.description: Not only did the Calamity bring with it destruction, pain, and suffering, but it also brought with it mandragoras. Thousands and thousands of mandragoras. Mandragoras who, if not dealt with swiftly and firmly, will continue to multiply until the land is overrun with the creatures.

entries.name: Go Wespe
entries.description: The Yellowjackets stationed in middle La Noscea have a royal problem. Wespes so large the smallfolk have dubbed them “kings” are terrorizing the countryside and need to be dethroned immediately.

entries.name: A Mad, Mad, Mad Sergeant
entries.description: The storm soldiers stationed at the De Nevelle Checkpoint are short a few men, and require volunteers to aid them with their regular training exercises in which they attempt to fend off a mock imperial assault.

entries.name: Thwack-a-Mole
entries.description: The orchards of middle La Noscea are riddled with dangerous holes dug by Moraby moles. It is high time the pests were given a good thumping.

entries.name: Yellow-bellied Greenbacks
entries.description: The newest batch of Yellowjacket recruits is softer than a rotten rat corpse, and fights little better. Whip the raw lads into shape. And remember, mercy is the last thing they need.

entries.name: On the Lamb
entries.description: A flock of sheep bitten by diseased bats has grown frenzied and is charging at full speed towards the Zephyr Gate. The infected creatures cannot be allowed to enter the city, so they must be driven off or put down.

entries.name: The Orange Boxes
entries.description: Crates of freshly picked oranges waiting to be delivered to Galadion Bay's pleasure boats are in danger of being infested by rats lured by the sweet smell of the fruit. Drive back the vermin until the chocobo caravan arrives.

entries.name: Shearing Is Caring
entries.description: Shearing Sheridan has been shearing his share of luckless passersby since long before the Calamity. What the megalocrab needs now is a good shell-shocking.

entries.name: The Boy Who Cried Jackal
entries.description: A young porter thought it would be clever to fool his companions into believing that they were being stalked by a pack of jackals so while the others were off hunting the beasts, he could slip off and frolic with a local milkmaid. The only problem being, jackals truly were stalking him, and now he's in a pickle.

entries.name: Sister Crustacean
entries.description: A spawning megalocrab will do whatever it takes to see its brood safe, and that includes slicing in half Lalafellin fishers who draw too close to the wavekin's unhatched offspring. Slay a crab, save a lad.

entries.name: Hello, Work
entries.description: During the Calamity, many bands of pirates lost their ships to either Garlean attackers or the flames of Bahamut. Most found new crews to join, but those who didn't simply turned to banditry on land. Use your blades to convince the lads it is high time they seek new employment.

entries.name: The Truth Is out There
entries.description: Middle La Noscea is abuzz following sightings of the Chupacabra─a dog-like creature rumored to drink the blood of virgins. Is the beast real, or just a legend!?

entries.name: Taking It to the Streams
entries.description: The Rogue River has become a breeding ground for giant carnivorous fish known as pugils. Help clear the shallows so the local fishers can cast their lines in relative peace.

entries.name: Crying over Spilled Salt
entries.description: Coastal winds blow floating aureliae from their native habitat over the Rhotano Sea to the shores of middle La Noscea, where they release their salty ballast onto the soil, rendering it unsuitable for farming. Slay the creatures before they become the salt of the earth.

entries.name: One Prince
entries.description: While little is known about mandragoras, what is known tends to be quite disturbing. Such is the case with the mandragora prince, who is rumored to journey to the sites of slaughters so it might feed off the blood-soaked loam. It is probably best to not let it feed off the blood-soaked loam.

entries.name: Fight the Flower
entries.description: They say every rose has its thorn. When it comes to roselings, however, thorns are the least of your problems. The strangling vines, the poisonous pollen, the ability to rise up from the ground and chase you all the way into your nightmares─these make roselings a force to be reckoned with...and the day of reckoning is come.

entries.name: You Call That a Toad
entries.description: When the wheat farmers of lower La Noscea were losing large portions of their crops to locusts, they turned to Mealvaan's Gate who introduced Cieldalaes cane toads to the fields to devour the vilekin. Unfortunately, the cane toads, who have no natural predators on Vylbrand, have taken over the region, leaving the farms with no choice but to slay them all.

entries.name: Caving In
entries.description: The cave bats living in Blind Iron Mines are believed to carry in their bite a sickness which can cause a man to froth at the mouth and lust after the blood of his kin. While this has not actually been proven, when it comes to bat bites, it is better to be safe than sorry.

entries.name: Man of the Flour
entries.description: Galagos from nearby Raincatcher Gully have found their way into the granaries which store the flour milled by the Grey Fleet. Why galagos would want flour when there are berries aplenty in the jungle is a mystery that might never be solved because the millers want those galagos dead.

entries.name: I Melt with You
entries.description: Some creatures are best left alone. Cuachac is a giant jellyfish which consumes its prey by stunning it with its poisonous tentacles, then dousing it in a corrosive liquid which slowly reduces the prey into an easy-to-digest pile of gelatinous ooze. Cuachac is best not left alone. Cuachac must be slain.

entries.name: Away in a Bilge Hold
entries.description: Men of a Yellowjacket patrol have cornered a stowaway they believe might be the notorious Ahctstymm Shadowlurker, but the ne'er-do-well has elected to put up a fight. The Yellowjackets could use any aid nearby adventurers might offer.

entries.name: In the Name of Love
entries.description: Unemployed pirates Anselm Larkscall and Fiebras the Dull are fighting again, more than likely over the same woman they were with last night. A little cold steel should help the two cool their heads.

entries.name: Don't Drink the Water
entries.description: Despite being surrounded on all sides by the sea, fresh water remains difficult to come by on Vylbrand, which is why the few springs that do exist must be protected at all costs from blighted dodos and jackals who come to the water to drink...and defecate.

entries.name: Enter Beastman
entries.description: The kobolds of O'Ghomoro have once again descended into Cedarwood, blatantly disregarding the treaty formed between the beast tribe and Limsa Lominsa which strictly forbids the kobolds from extending their claims beyond the northern reaches of outer La Noscea. Drive the creatures back to the mountains whence they came.

entries.name: One Pickman Enters
entries.description: Enraged by their defeat in Cedarwood, the kobolds have summoned one of their champions, 426th Order Pickman Bu Ga, to avenge the loss. Make swift work of the creature so he knows not to return.

entries.name: Finding Wine
entries.description: A band of buccaneers is bound for the borders of the bustling borough of Wineport in search of beverages to sate their bacchanalian cravings. Steer the scoundrels from the settlement while seeing they stay sober.

entries.name: The Thirst
entries.description: A band of parched buccaneers are looking to quench their thirsts the pirate way─a good old-fashioned raid─and have gathered in a copse near Wineport to hammer out their plan of attack. Join the Maelstrom in stopping the attack before it can happen.

entries.name: Thrill of the Hunt
entries.description: A moment in the bushes to drain the morning dew is all it took for a poor Lominsan merchant to be left behind by his caravan. Now, to make matters worse, he is being tracked by a pack of raptors who see the hapless hawker as naught more than a light snack. Slay the scalekin and protect the merchant.

entries.name: The Pelican Briefing
entries.objective: Deliver the pelican eggs to Jijiroon.
entries.description: Jijiroon of Jijiroon's Trading Post is looking to replenish his stock of pelican eggs─a favorite amongst Qiqirn─and has traveled all the way to eastern La Noscea to do so. Assist the enterprising beastman by slaying pelicans, collecting their eggs, and delivering them before they hatch!

entries.name: Them
entries.description: A cluster of red mantis eggs has hatched and now the jungle is crawling with tiny red monsters. If not put down immediately, the jungle will soon be crawling with giant red monsters!

entries.name: Careless Whiskers
entries.description: A flea-ridden pack of Qiqirn is attempting to transform the sorely undermanned Gullperch Tower into a rat nest. Drive the beastmen off before they get a tailhold.

entries.name: No Lip
entries.objective: Deliver the shells to the oyster-hunting maiden.
entries.description: The Bloodshore colibri are devouring the area's rainbowlip oysters, leaving none for the poor young women who maintain their livelihood by selling the shells to Ul'dahn goldsmiths. Slay the gluttonous birds and retrieve the shells from the corpses' bellies.

entries.name: Jewels of the Isle
entries.description: Notorious sneak thief Kokoroon Quickfingers has been sighted swiping jewelry from the lockboxes of wealthy Costa del Sol retirees. Find the bandit and give him a good thumping.

entries.name: Crab and Go
entries.description: Giant crabs known as snippers have invaded the once-pristine beaches of Bloodshore, making it difficult for Costa del Sol retirees to take their morning walks without having their raiments sliced to ribbons. The problem requires immediate attention, and adventurers are sought to cull the sidestepping sea creatures.

entries.name: Follow the Light
entries.description: The mischievous spirits of fallen pirates are luring drowsy Costa del Sol retirees from their bedchambers into the churning sea. Save the poor septuagenarians so that they may continue to spend their hard-earned wealth at the Flying Shark. Now open for brunch!

entries.name: Just a Matter of Rut
entries.description: The buffaloes of Bloodshore are in rut, and a shortage of females this season means that the males who have yet to find mates are especially violent. Deal with the roused beasts before they harm themselves or others.

entries.name: Absolutely, Positively
entries.description: An important missive from the Admiral must be delivered to South Tidegate. See to it the storm courier tasked with carrying the message reaches her destination unharmed.

entries.name: Tender Buttons
entries.description: Gluttonous Gertrude was just another plump dodo on the farm...until she bit the arse off one of the stable boys at Swiftperch and escaped into Quarterstone. Seek out the ravenous bird and slay her before another rump goes missing.

entries.name: Shredding Wheat
entries.description: The wheat fields abandoned after the Calamity have turned into a breeding ground for wild animals who prey on Swiftperch's crops and stock. Drive the creatures from the overgrowth and slay as many as possible.

entries.name: (I Just) Died in Six Arms Tonight
entries.description: It is believed most crabs only live for two to three years─fewer if nearby Lominsans are hungry. There is one crab, however, that is rumored to have survived since the Fifth Astral Era, surviving on the blood of man (though no one can truly back that claim). All things must die, and Old Six-arms's time has come.

entries.name: Iron Contra Affair
entries.objective: Deliver the crates of contraband to the Yellowjacket captain.
entries.description: Goblins from Iron Lake, now encamped in Skull Valley, are peddling items strictly prohibited by thalassocratic decree. Yellowjackets stationed in the area are seeking to confiscate the contraband and are entreating adventurers for aid.

entries.name: Don't Call Him a Fishback
entries.description: The Serpent Reavers─mindless servants of the Sahagin─are raiding the farmsteads of western La Noscea, killing the men, savaging the women, and selling the children into servitude. Aid the Maelstrom in putting these foul turncloaks down.

entries.name: Letters from Tidegate
entries.description: A letter carrier tasked with delivering messages from soldiers on the front lines back to their loved ones in Limsa Lominsa is being harassed by bandits who seek to claim the personal effects enclosed in the packages. Slay the perpetrators and defend the young man.

entries.name: The Last Straw
entries.description: What nature did not reclaim of Quarterstone after the Calamity, the dodos did, but now it is time to take the land back. Destroy nests and drive the cloudkin from the fields, so that the settlers might piece back together their lives.

entries.name: Barometz Soup
entries.description: Already known for its size in the Sixth Astral Era, the overgrown landtrap Barometz has grown even larger since the Calamity, feeding on weakened dodos and aldgoats until reaching its current size of almost two score hands. Slice it down to size, or you might be its next victim!

entries.name: Goblin Chain
entries.description: A band of goblins turned away from Aleport is taking out its frustrations on the hamlet by blockading its entrance. Put the creatures down so that business may carry on as usual.

entries.name: Tryp Fantastic
entries.description: The goblins encamped in Skull Valley have hired a named mercenary to help them raid the nearby farmsteads. Hunt down Tryptix Stumblemox and slay him.

entries.name: Between Aurochs
entries.description: Several aurochs have begun grazing alongside the De Nevelle Westroad, frightening merchants and preventing the transport of goods to and from the area. Use any means necessary to urge the beasts from the thoroughfare.

entries.name: In the Sac
entries.description: A killer mantis egg sac has burst open, releasing countless of the deadly vilekin into western La Noscea. It is best they are slain now while young before given the opportunity to live up to their name.

entries.name: Simurgh Is the Word
entries.description: Simurgh, a colossal cloudkin who is thought to nest high upon O'Ghomoro, has descended into upper La Noscea to feed─his prey of choice? Lalafells. Slay the creature before he finds his next tender, juicy victim.

entries.name: Surprise
entries.description: A lightly armed Maelstrom transportation unit en route to Camp Overlook has been ambushed by a band of savage kobolds. Fend off the assailants and protect the supply troops to ensure that the unit can complete its delivery.

entries.name: The Road More Traveled
entries.description: A party of Mamool Ja mercenaries hired by the local kobolds is attacking travelers using the main thoroughfares through upper La Noscea. Engage the mercenaries and make them regret ever taking this contract.

entries.name: Nine-ilm Snails
entries.description: Not a day passes without the physickers of the Warmwine Sanitorium having to clean their bathing pools of uragnite hatchlings, and they have had enough. They seek volunteers to hunt down and slay the root of the problem─the adult creatures laying the eggs in the springs.

entries.name: Truth in Faerie Tales
entries.description: Legend says deep beneath the waters of Bronze Lake dwells a terrible creature with jaws so powerful they can tear a man in two with a single bite. Common sense would suggest that Oannes is merely a tale to frighten babes, but the local smallfolk would have us believe otherwise.

entries.name: Giant Enemy Crab
entries.description: A crab released into Bronze Lake by Qiqirn so that the beastmen might harvest its sweet eggs has grown into an uncontrollable nuisance. Not only does it not produce any eggs of its own (on the account of being a male), it also ravages the nests of the local waterfowl, devouring their eggs. Karkinos must be slain.

entries.name: Shell Shocked
entries.description: Heated by the molten rock coursing deep below O'Ghomoro, the waters of Bronze Lake are warm year-round. This unique environment has allowed creatures, which normally only grow to a few ilms, to balloon into terrifying monstrosities. The wavekin Zoredonite is one such abomination.

entries.name: Peeping Ja
entries.description: After repeatedly harassing a party of Miqo'te bathers, a Mamool Ja mercenary who goes by the name of Scarface Bugaal Ja was banned for life from the hot springs at Camp Bronze Lake. The degenerate, however, is back once again, and must needs be dealt with.

entries.name: Hop, Skip, and a Jump
entries.description: A plague of waterskipper yarzons has converged upon the shores of Bronze Lake, looking to lay eggs. Waterskipper numbers are already at an all-time high, and if any more were allowed to hatch, the area would be overrun with the ravenous pests. Slay the yarzons before they can mate.

entries.name: Under the Bridge
entries.description: More and more merchants are refusing to make the trip to the Gods' Grip due to rumors of a giant wolflike creature called Padfoot who is said to hide below Oschon's Embrace, attacking any who attempt to cross the bridge. Hunt the beast down and restore peace to the area.

entries.name: Consigned, Sealed, and Undelivered
entries.description: An important client of Master Gegeruju's─one Aismurl Goldmember─is visiting Costa del Sol to complete a sizable business transaction. To ensure that things go smoothly, the master has prepared a special incentive for his guest...and she requires proper escort to Hidden Falls.

entries.name: It's Not Lupus
entries.description: Claws so powerful they can split a rock in two. A shell so hard, not even the hammer of a mighty hecatoncheir can crack it. Cancer, a crab rumored to have been spawned in the heavens, has appeared in eastern La Noscea. Slay him and become the stuff of legends!

entries.name: The Mandragoras
entries.description: Sensing weakness in the realm following the Calamity, five rogue vegetables (well, technically four and a fruit) have risen up to rid the land of all meat─including YOU. Cool off the Mandragoras before their verdant insurgence gains steam.

entries.name: Needles to Slay
entries.description: Needles shed by cactuars are the number four cause of foot irritation in all western Thanalan. By slaying a few cactuars, we can see that number drop to sixth, or even seventh!

entries.name: Things that Make You Go Home
entries.description: Land purchased by a wealthy real estate mogul for development into luxury estates has become overrun with yarzons. Slay the vilekin before someone sees them and property values drop.

entries.name: Deface the Facts
entries.description: Now banished from Ul'dah for various acts of vandalism and basic thuggery, a gang of unruly, yet simply adorable, goblin muggers has made its way to Hammerlea where the beastmen have found a new favorite pastime─the destruction of random items lying about the Hammers. It is time they were shown some tough love.

entries.name: Please Hammers, Don't Hurt Them
entries.description: Hammer beaks have drawn too close to the Silver Bazaar for comfort, causing many a sleepless night for the hamlet's residents. Become the anvil which stops the cloudkin's advance.

entries.name: The Cores
entries.objective: Deliver the cores to the diligent worker.
entries.description: The workers of Hammerlea require earth sprite cores to help harden the land before they can drive their massive piles.

entries.name: Doomed
entries.description: Before the Calamity, the Brass Blades were flooded with reports of a giant toad-like creature roaming the desert, lapping up poor Lalafellin travelers with its long, sticky tongue. Now, ten summers later, rumors of a “doomed gigantoad” are surfacing once again.

entries.name: The Villain
entries.description: No one knows why Cactuar Jack feels the need to rain his hundred needles down upon all who happen by, because few have lived long enough to ask him...not that he would answer if he were asked, or that anyone would be able to understand him if he were to answer.

entries.name: Copied Peistes
entries.description: The shorthanded Brass Blades desperately seek aid in ridding the area of deadly peistes, who, without any predators save man, continue to multiply at an alarming rate.

entries.name: Dog Eat Dog
entries.description: Feral packs of diseased dogs roam the desert attacking anyone carrying anything resembling food...or anyone resembling food, for that matter. Put the beasts down before a poor Lalafell becomes lunch.

entries.name: Bigger Fish to Fry
entries.description: Unable or unwilling to tackle larger prey, orobon tend to feed on young fish. The lack of young fish leads to an eventual lack of old fish, putting those fishers of Crescent Cove who rely on the sea's bounty to make their living in quite a predicament. Help solve their trouble by dealing with the root of the problem.

entries.name: Bubble Trouble
entries.description: Several crab-loving fishers have journeyed to the Footfalls in search of a giant delicacy-to-be known to the locals as Bubbly Bernie. Unfortunately, without some help, it looks like the fishers are going to be the ones to get served.

entries.name: Tripped Up by the Fruit of Another
entries.description: A merchant en route to Vesper Bay was attacked by a pack of jackals after slipping and falling on a sun lemon rind left discarded by a traveling lemoncake monger. He requests an escort to the port town as he does not believe he can make it alone.

entries.name: Juggernaut Down
entries.description: A unit of Garlean soldiers is sifting through the wreckage of a fallen imperial juggernaut, presumably searching for any salvageable pieces of magitek equipment. Engage the unit and see its members are unable to report their findings to Castrum Marinum.

entries.name: A Matter of Rust
entries.description: After devouring all the ore remaining in a nearby abandoned mine, a sizable pack of coblyns has set out into the desert in search of new feeding grounds. Amajina & Sons will suffer the pilfering of their yet-to-be-claimed resources no more, and seek the immediate eradication of the pests.

entries.name: There Might Be Giants
entries.description: A giant in Thanalan! It is not yet known whence he came, but it is known whither he must needs go─straight to the seventh hell!

entries.name: Pound for Pound
entries.description: The incessant hammering of hammer beaks' hammer-like beaks is causing local settlers a great deal of lost sleep. Help the poor smallfolk strike at their problem while the iron is hot.

entries.name: He's Got Legs
entries.description: Unofficial studies conducted by unauthorized persons claim that more Ul'dahn children are orphaned by bloody attacks on their parents by a terrible creature called Daddy Longlegs than by any other means. In the time you take to question this claim, another child may be orphaned. Are you willing to take that risk!?

entries.name: Staying Dead
entries.description: The restless spirits of fishers lost at sea have wandered back, unable to break their ties with the corporeal world. Purify these poor souls so that they may continue their journey into Thal's realm.

entries.name: Something to Prove
entries.description: Ever since being denied entry into the Pugilists', Gladiators', Lancers', Marauders', and Archers' Guilds, Grishild the Ungood has taken to challenging anyone and everyone to duels, hoping to prove her detractors wrong. Or perhaps she's simply a masochist.

entries.name: Like an Eft out of Water
entries.description: Drawn by the sumptuous scent of roasting meat and hot mulled wine, efts have crawled out from the muddy flats of their normal habitat to dine at nearby cookfires. Slay a few so that the kindly father may roast them up for his starveling sons.

entries.name: Wrecked Rats
entries.description: Cockeyed Qiqirn denied entry to the Coffer & Coffin have not taken the news well and are causing trouble for the heavy who was hired to keep characters like these from causing trouble. Lend the poor lad a hand in helping the beastmen sober up.

entries.name: Survivor Rats
entries.description: A band of Qiqirn bandits has left its camp in search of fresh prey, and the Brass Blades are bent on seeing the beastmen's efforts end in failure. All aid provided by adventurers will be noted and duly rewarded.

entries.name: Cracked
entries.description: As his colorful moniker suggests, notorious Qiqirn bandit Babaroon Halfshell prefers his prey firm on the outside and runny on the inside─something to keep in mind when he has you in an iron cookpot, boiling over an open flame. Now get cracking before he grows hungry.

entries.name: Orobon Part Two: The Spawning
entries.description: A poor boy whose father was eaten by an orobon (yes, an orobon) has sworn bloody revenge against the terrible wavekin who rendered him a starveling orphan. While it won't bring his father back, the indiscriminate slaying of random orobon may just help restore the sparkle in the young boy's eyes.

entries.name: Let them Eat Cactus
entries.objective: Deliver the leaves to the hungry hobbledehoy.
entries.description: Appalled that the displaced souls living in the shantytowns beneath the towering city walls of Ul'dah are driven to eat rat tails and coblyn legs just to survive, the sultana has ordered her subjects to procure edible cactus leaves and distribute them to the starving masses.

entries.name: For the Queen
entries.description: Giant antling sentries are on the march, most likely in search of Lalafellin children to snatch up and take back to their queen. Slay the vilekin before they catch the scent of a plump, innocent morsel.

entries.name: A Few Arrows Short of a Quiver
entries.objective: Return the stolen shipping crates to the crestfallen merchant.
entries.description: The summer home of Eolande Quiveron─former Syndicate member, before tragically losing her life in the Calamity─has been occupied by thieving bandits, one even claiming, in fact, to be the noble lady's heir. Rumor has it the bandits use the run-down manor to hide their booty, and a merchant is seeking aid in recovering his stolen goods.

entries.name: Big Time
entries.description: Fear of being pummeled by sledgehammer beaks is preventing miners from delivering their ore to assayers in Ul'dah. The Brass Blades seek help in clearing the Royal Allagan Starway of any and all threats.

entries.name: Cold-blooded
entries.description: A terrible monster, known as Vodyanoi, living in the pools beneath the Unholy Heir has been seen dragging his victims into the water, where he lies upon them until they asphyxiate. One would think that the wavekin then eats his prey, but such is not the case, as the corpses are left to drift in the pools until they are consumed by jackals and carrion crows. Could it be that Vodyanoi kills merely for pleasure!?

entries.name: A Warm Welcome
entries.description: Descended from Coerthas in search of warm stones, a spriggan known in the north as Spitfire is terrorizing the local smallfolk and hoarding precious ores and gems intended for sale to the Goldsmiths' Guild. Give the crafty creature a good cuffing and send him on his way back home.

entries.name: Leaving the Nest
entries.description: The nest commander─a giant antling from Hellsbrood Holes─is out hunting again. Volunteers are wanted to see the violent vilekin slain.

entries.name: Men Who See Goats
entries.description: Packs of wild myotragus have left their mountain homes to forage in the lowlands. The beastkin are known to eat anything and everything, and if not stopped and driven back to the crags, they will more than likely consume what precious little foliage remains in Thanalan.

entries.name: License to Quill
entries.description: Tuco-tuco quills are prized for their durability, and sought by weavers across the realm to use as sewing and knitting needles. The spines of steelquill tuco-tucos, however, are a different story. When shed along the Royal Sunway, they can cause grievous injuries to chocobos and other beasts of burden who use the roads. Slay steelquill tuco-tucos, and keep the thoroughfares clear.

entries.name: Westward Bound
entries.description: An Amalj'aa unit has been sighted moving west, most likely to establish a new encampment closer to Ul'dah. The safety of the city-state is at stake. Crush the beastmen and send them running back to Zanr'ak.

entries.name: Bad Camp
entries.description: The Amalj'aa stationed in their eastern Thanalan encampment have begun preparing for a large-scale foray into Ul'dahn territory. Foil their plans by destroying supply crates and slaying the encampment leader, Glassjaw Nazagg Gah.

entries.name: Bazaar Blood Triangle
entries.description: A unit of Amalj'aa raiders has forced its way into the Golden Bazaar in search of slaves and supplies. Aid the Brass Blades stationed in the hamlet in fending off the attackers.

entries.name: Grim Undertakings
entries.description: A malevolent spirit, freed from his subterranean prison when the Calamity unearthed the Invisible City, is indiscriminately attacking those who journey into the ruins in search of fortune and knowledge. Seek out the Undertaker and release his soul from the fetters of the corporeal realm.

entries.name: Simple Minds
entries.description: A gang of mischievous imps fancying themselves footpads has taken to assaulting travelers passing through eastern Thanalan. Chase off the voidsent and see the roads safe once more.

entries.name: Manifest Destiny
entries.description: Amalj'aa lancers approach from the east! Engage the beastmen before they can reach Highbridge.

entries.name: Spare the Hair
entries.description: An old wives' tale states that if the monster Gossamer comes to you in your sleep, you will awake as bald as a melon. Middle-aged men across the realm, unite─for the bane must be quelled!

entries.name: Desert Rose
entries.description: Riding on the dry north winds out of the Black Shroud, kedtrap seeds have taken root in Thanalan. Without any natural predators, the seedkin are free to roam the desert unchecked, consuming everything in their path. The creatures must be tended to before they render the desert even more deserted than it already is!

entries.name: Almost Paradise
entries.description: Anyone who has been to Drybone can easily see how the place earned its name. It is an unforgiving place─arid and dry beyond compare. What little water can be found in the area is so prized, men have been known to trade gold just for a sip. This is why the few springs must be protected from those who would foul them─slugs.

entries.name: Deep in the Heart of Sagolii
entries.description: Elder longhorns are extremely territorial and will attack anything which draws too close to their dens. This is fine when those dens are at the top of unscalable peaks, but when they lie within earshot of well-traveled caravan roads, things can become quite hairy. Drive the goats back to the mountains where they belong.

entries.name: Adventures in Throat Slitting
entries.description: The leader of the ill-famed Corpse Brigade, Milleuda the Slitter, has finally emerged from hiding to lead her men on a raid into the nearby hills. Use the opportunity to slay the killer and bring an end to her bloody reign.

entries.name: The Corpse Bribe
entries.description: Once an arm of the proud Ala Mhigan army, the Corpse Brigade has devolved into a band of bandits and petty thieves, albeit well-trained ones. Several of the former soldiers earn their keep by setting up illegal roadblocks and demanding coin for passage. Show the curs that the sultana will not allow such acts under her rule.

entries.name: Downwind
entries.description: A pack of violent sandskin peistes has been drawn to Little Ala Mhigo by the stench of the latrine pits which surround the mesa caves the Ala Mhigan refugees call home. While many of the settlers can hold their own in a fight, the sheer number of peistes may prove too much for the encampment.

entries.name: Soul Man
entries.objective: Deliver golem soulstones to the Ul'dahn naturalist.
entries.description: A naturalist from Ul'dah is seeking to discover the secrets behind the force animating the silent stone creatures guarding the ruins at the Sunken Temple of Qarn, and will pay good gil for each soulstone extracted from the hearts of the golems.

entries.name: Bigger than Life
entries.description: Naturalists claim that it can take almost four score summers for an adamantoise to grow to full size. If that is to be believed, then one can only imagine how many summers it took for Aspidochelone to achieve its colossal mass...or how much it had to consume.

entries.name: Heroes of the 2nd
entries.description: The Immortal Flames 2nd Main Brigade is moving to assault an Amalj'aa strongpoint and seeks reinforcements to help prevent its ranks from being flanked by the enemy.

entries.name: Diamond in the Rough
entries.description: A great Ul'dahn general once said, “There is no need for defense when one is always on the offensive.” Assault the Zanr'ak encampment and slay the commanding officer Diamondjaw Nezedd Gah before he gathers his troops to march on Little Ala Mhigo.

entries.name: Children of the Sands
entries.description: The U tribe of Forgotten Springs, also known as the Children of the Sands, has gathered for the hunt. Join the savage beauties as they test their mettle against the giant sandworms of the Sagolii.

entries.name: Return to Cinder
entries.description: The Zanr'ak altar is used to augur the outcome of future battles between the Amalj'aa and Ul'dah, and it is Cindersoot Pegujj Chah who throws the bones. Slay the mesmerizer and see that his fortune-telling days come to a bloody end.

entries.name: Hunters and the Hunted
entries.description: A party of Amalj'aa warriors has gone foraging into Ul'dahn territory, raiding granaries and claiming livestock. Intercept the beastmen and beat them back to their mountain stronghold.

entries.name: From Point A
entries.description: Relics uncovered from the ruins at Byregot's Strike must first be cataloged in Forgotten Springs before being delivered to Arrzaneth Ossuary for further study. Escort the Stone Torch tasked with transporting the items from the dig site to the oasis, and see that she arrives safely.

entries.name: Run Like a Flame
entries.description: A flame scout caught spying on the Amalj'aa in Zanr'ak has escaped his captors and is making way to the aetheryte in Little Ala Mhigo, so that he may relay his findings to the Hall of Flames. The Amalj'aa, however, are in close pursuit and will do anything to see that their secrets remain hidden. Protect the scout at all costs!

entries.name: Blood, Augur, Hex, Magicks
entries.description: The Immortal Flames have pinpointed the whereabouts of one Blackbile Maladd Chah─an Amalj'aa hexweaver thought to be behind the assassinations of several high-ranking flame officials. Track down the terrible warlock and send him back to the Lifestream.

entries.name: Fish out of Water
entries.description: During the Calamity, the land's aetherial balance was disturbed─the result being a myriad of unexplained phenomena which has botanists and naturalists puzzled. What the scholars can agree on, however, is that the balance must be restored, and that means eradicating the problems as they emerge─and anglers in the desert certainly can be classified as one of those problems.

entries.name: Harder, Bigger, Faster, Stronger
entries.description: After years of experimentation, Amalj'aa beast tamers have finally perfected a new breed of biologically augmented drakes and have moved to testing the creatures in the field. Use this opportunity to slay the war creatures before they are taken back to their cages.

entries.name: With One Eye Open
entries.description: Since the Calamity, the workers of Bluefog have told stories of a terrible one-eyed creature who would come in the night to carry sleeping men away from their campfires, never to be seen again. No one believed them...until a high-ranking Ul'dahn noble was snatched from his caravan. Now the city-state wants this Arimaspi's blinker on a pike.

entries.name: Under the Nails
entries.description: Plans to expand the Ceruleum Processing Plant are in motion, with the next step being to clear the nearby land of the massive crystal protrusions known as Dalamud's Talons. To do that, however, the area must first be rid of the hostile basilisks who hunt there.

entries.name: Boom Goes the Ceruleum
entries.description: Ceruleum is a highly flammable substance, and even the tiniest of sparks could cause an explosion, which is why the Ceruleum Processing Plant in Bluefog is especially wary of voidsent grenades straying too near the storage and rendering tanks.

entries.name: Knock on Steel
entries.description: The imperial army's mad engineers have developed a new grade of armor plating for their warmachina and are already testing it out on their magitek vanguards. If the Grand Companies of Eorzea are to stand against the Empire, they must know the extent of Garlemald's defenses; thus, they seek adventurers to test their weapons on these mechanical beasts.

entries.name: Poor Maid's Mess
entries.description: Most likely assuming that there would still be poor maids living there, former-pirates-turned-model-citizens have exchanged their cutlasses for brooms and hammers in an effort to restore Poor Maid's Mill to its former pre-Calamity glory. Aid the men and women in clearing the farmstead of rats who now infest the ruins.

entries.name: Poor Maid's Mishap
entries.description: A band of kobolds led by 382nd Order Pickman Ge Bu has descended on Poor Maid's Mill in search of food and supplies. Aid the Salthounds in driving back the beastmen and defeating their commander.

entries.name: Poor Maid's Misfortune
entries.description: The Salthounds looking to restore Poor Maid's Mill cannot seem to catch a break, as now a pack of bloodthirsty coeurls has surrounded the ruins and has already dragged a few of the injured boatswains off into the wood. Join hands with the former pirates as they attempt to defend their little piece of La Noscea.

entries.name: Poor Maid's Misadventure
entries.description: If it isn't diseased rats, thieving kobolds, or bloodthirsty coeurls threatening to undo all the Salthounds have accomplished at Poor Maid's Mill, it's frenzied buffaloes looking to stomp the old farmstead into oblivion. Join with the former pirates one last time to see that all their efforts weren't for naught.

entries.name: Revenge of the Worms
entries.description: At a glance, sandworms seem little more than mindless minions of the desert, but it is now believed that each worm is bound to the others in their community, forming a sort of “hive mind” which recognizes when one part of the group has been injured or killed. This hive mind is now guiding a swarm of the worms towards Forgotten Springs to exact revenge on the U tribe.

entries.name: Bump and Grind
entries.description: The Brass Blades seek volunteers to aid them in the capture or slaying of Corpse Brigade captain Gisfrid the Grinder.

entries.name: Reverse Engineering
entries.objective: Deliver engine parts to the draughtsman.
entries.description: An engineering expert employed by Amajina & Sons seeks to uncover the secrets of the ceruleum engines which breathe life into the Empire's warmachina and will pay good coin for any engine parts brought back to him, regardless of their condition.

entries.name: Twelve Ilms of Snow
entries.description: A pack of starving snow wolves has descended from its hunting grounds on the Nail to prey upon those who reside in and around the Observatorium. Drive the pack back to the mountains before there are any more casualties.

entries.name: Baa Baa Black Sheep
entries.description: A legend amongst local Coerthan shepherds, Downy Dunstan is said to have wool as black as night and as soft as cloud. The problem is, most are never able to get close enough to the sheep to shear him properly, and those who are usually end up sacrificing a finger or two in the attempt. If someone were to pacify the beast, there would surely be those who would pay generously.

entries.name: Gavial
entries.description: Nobles and their pets. One day they will see some tiny creature from the window of their pillowed carriage and simply have to have it...that is, until it grows too large and violent for their quaint seaside villa, at which time they order their majordomo to toss it back into the wild, it now having learned to loathe all who might take advantage of it once again, until it finally has to be put down.

entries.name: Whiteout
entries.description: A blinding snowstorm on Abalathia's Spine has caused a pack of goobbues to lose its way and wander down into the more heavily populated areas of the Coerthas highlands. The creatures have already begun feeding on the locals' stock, and if not dealt with soon, there will be nothing left with which to survive the coming winter.

entries.name: A Log Up
entries.description: The Dravanian Horde launched a brutal assault on the Observatorium just as her astrologians began moving this moon's astroscope logs to the lower library. Adventurers are needed to fend off the attack while protecting the scattered logs from the thrustaevis's all-consuming flames.

entries.name: Croc-y Road
entries.description: A porter on his way to Camp Dragonhead has had his way blocked by a bask of feral crocs. He doesn't dare stray too far from Haldrath's March for fear of being assaulted in the wild, but unless the crocs are dealt with, he will be unable to proceed to his destination.

entries.name: The Grey
entries.description: Since getting his leg caught in an iron trap, a sentry of House Fortemps has been tracked by a pack of wolves following the scent of his blood. The pack is right on his heels and without aid, he will not make it back to Ishgard alive.

entries.name: Simply Red
entries.description: A party of redhorn ogres has left its mountain lair to raid the smallfolk villages. It is not enough that they steal their food, but they kidnap their women and children as well. The poor farmers have no means of stopping these voidsent creatures, their fate balanced on the kindness of strangers.

entries.name: Spring Forward, Fall Back
entries.objective: Deliver the phials of Daniffen's tears to the merchant.
entries.description: A Coerthan merchant come to the Weeping Saint to collect holy water has found the spring guarded by mischievous sprites. Not willing to return to Ishgard empty-handed, he is offering to purchase any phials filled from the pool.

entries.name: A Fire in the Distance
entries.description: Nothing is worse than being caught in a snowstorm at night than being caught in a snowstorm at night and falling into a bottomless ravine because you thought you spied a lantern in the distance...which actually turned out to be a will-o'-the-wisp. The wisps must be slain, for the safety of travelers throughout the realm.

entries.name: Coming to a Head
entries.description: The Dravanian Horde has begun surrounding Camp Dragonhead. The knights stationed at the outpost seek aid in driving back the scalekin, for they do not believe their reinforcements from Ishgard will arrive in time.

entries.name: Bellyful
entries.description: A ferocious fiend named Gargamelle, rumored to have devoured twelve sick orphans being carried to the Warmwine Sanitorium for treatment, has been spotted hiding in an ice cave known as the Ogre's Belly. Put a blade through its black heart before it can claim any more innocent victims.

entries.name: A Freeze Is Coming
entries.description: The fall of Dalamud brought an endless winter to the hills of Coerthas, and with the cold there came creatures of pure ice whose mere existence further rimes the land. Lutin is one of those creatures.

entries.name: Giant Seps
entries.description: Many fine Ishgardian knights have fallen to the Dravanian Horde, but one dragon in particular has claimed more lives than most─its name, Seps. The winged aberration must be slain if the souls of its victims are to rest in peace.

entries.name: Riddle Me This
entries.description: Giants demanding answers to their riddles three are preventing a party of naturalists from returning to Snowcloak. The problem is that even though the naturalists─learned men and women by trade─(somewhat) correctly answered all three riddles, the giants still refuse to let them pass. The only remaining solution is clear─answer the riddles with steel.

entries.name: Judge, Jury, and Executioner
entries.description: Dragonflies of the Dravanian Horde have gathered before Ishgard's final line of land defense─the Gates of Judgement. If the bastion is compromised, the Horde's wingless ground troops will gain entry to the city-state and thousands of lives will be lost. The gates must be defended at all costs.

entries.name: In the Saint's Wake
entries.description: Every year, pilgrims enter Coerthas to trace the steps of Saint Daniffen, who, long ago, journeyed across the realm, aiding the less fortunate. And, every year, a lustful creature known as Rongeur hides in the shadows along the roads to prey on these pilgrims.

entries.name: Tower of Power
entries.description: As if Ishgard already did not have its hands full with the Dravanian Horde, hostile bands of giants from the north have also descended on Coerthas to wreak their havoc. House Haillenarte guards seek assistance in driving one such band from the area surrounding Monument Tower.

entries.name: Turn Off Your Hearthlight
entries.description: Giants in search of fire to cook their prey have begun a chaotic march toward the hearths within the Observatorium. Join the House Durendaire guards in repelling the onslaught.

entries.name: What's on Your Mind
entries.description: Very little is known about the void other than that the laws that govern our realm do not always apply. In addition to one-eyed monstrosities, peculiar balls of fur, and nightmarish demons, oddities such as floating orbs of energy also periodically break through the boundaries that separate this realm from the void. Make no mistake, however, everything through those rifts does not belong in Eorzea and must be destroyed.

entries.name: The Bigger They Are
entries.description: Klythios, a leader and champion amongst the giants, has been spotted in the Coerthas highlands. If he is defeated, his dull-witted brethren are certain to think twice before venturing too deep into Ishgardian territory. Find the colossal warrior and send him toppling.

entries.name: Wish Upon a Star
entries.description: The previous evening's star readings are complete, and an astrologian from the Observatorium seeks well-armed adventurers to escort him as he delivers the findings to a courier at Camp Dragonhead, who will take them into Ishgard.

entries.name: The Taste of Fear
entries.description: Since breaking its way into one of the Skyfire Locks and devouring an entire family of refugees as they escaped the flames of the Dravanian Horde, the horrible scalekin Sebek has been sought by the knights of Ishgard to pay for its heinous crimes.

entries.name: Roc of Ages
entries.description: Skyfishing is the sole means of survival for countless Ishgardian skyfishers, the strange denizens of the Sea of Clouds crucial to maintaining the fishers' livelihoods. This is why when a giant bird with a seemingly insatiable appetite appears and begins devouring them all, the skyfishers take notice.

entries.name: Front and Center
entries.description: The Dravanian elders have ordered their minions to attack Whitebrim Front. Hold the line until Ishgardian reinforcements arrive or the elders sound the retreat.

entries.name: If This Wall Could Talk
entries.description: With a team of naturalists from across the realm working day and night to discover the origins of Snowcloak and how it might be destroyed, there is one thing they have uncovered─that energy from ice sprites actually works to increase the thickness of the wall. The research team seeks volunteers to clear the area of the pesky sprites.

entries.name: Does Anyone Hear It
entries.description: The Ixal are looking to expand their settlement of Natalan and have begun clear-cutting the nearby forests for wood. Infiltrate Natalan and destroy the lumber so as to slow the expansion's progress.

entries.name: The Four Winds
entries.description: The four sisters of the Hueloc high clan are feared even by their fellow Ixal for the lack of mercy they show their victims. Though it would be doing the beast tribe a favor, it will not only be the Ixal who benefit from the slaying of the Huelocs.

entries.name: Inspector Hatchet
entries.description: Gozol Itzcan the Hatchet is infamous for his endless raids into the Twelveswood to fell ancient sentinels. Track down the feathered fiend while he is perched in Natalan, and see that he never swings an axe again.

entries.name: Svara's Flight
entries.description: The Observatorium reports that the dragon Svara has been seen flying in the direction of the Steel Vigil. Protect the engineer moving into position to ready the siege machine.

entries.name: Svara's Fear
entries.description: The engineer is in position and has begun readying the dragonslayer cannons; however, deadly threats approach from all sides. Fend off the encroaching horde so that the engineer can finish his preparations.

entries.name: Svara's Fall
entries.description: The mighty dragon Svara has landed and begun its relentless attack on the Ishgardian defenses. Fight alongside Bertha to turn the tide of battle in your favor.

entries.name: Svara's Fury
entries.description: The mighty dragon Svara has landed and begun its relentless attack on the Ishgardian defenses. The cannon that was meant to aid the Ishgardian forces, however, has been destroyed. It appears your blades are the only thing that can prevent utter defeat this day.

entries.name: Behold Now Behemoth
entries.description: The legendary behemoth has left its mountaintop dominion to hunt...and we are his prey. Gather your blades and your wits and pray to the Twelve for strength, for you will need it to quell the beast's infinite rage.

entries.name: He Taketh It with His Eyes
entries.description: The behemoth has taken flight back to its dominion. Make chase and finish the legendary beast once and for all.

entries.name: The Eyes Have It
entries.description: After proving his might on the shores of Turtleback Island, the cyclops Steropes has returned to Eorzea, but this time with a personal army of giants who call themselves the Second Eyes. Defeat Steropes before he can cause any real damage.

entries.name: The Storm Caller
entries.description: Kozol Nomotl the Turbulent, chief among the rank of Ixali occultists, has come to Natalan to personally preside over the summoning of the primal Garuda. Slay the Ixal that the land might be spared a stormy fate.

entries.name: Toll Collector
entries.description: An adventurer returned to Camp Revenant's Toll to see if she could locate items abandoned there five years past has found the site overrun with poisonous gigantoads. She seeks assistance in clearing away the wavekin.

entries.name: Mud about You
entries.description: The endless maze of roots and trees already creates enough trouble for those travelers who brave the Tangle; the last thing any of them want to think upon is how to fend off a pack of hungry mudpuppies. Clear the waters of these wavekin, but ware the morbols lurking nearby.

entries.name: Black and Nburu
entries.description: The adventurers of Revenant's Toll whisper rumors of a long-dead spirit who is damned to roam the Tangle for eternity, preying on the souls of the living out of pure spite─his name, Nburu.

entries.name: Good to Be Bud
entries.description: When a morbol begins to bud, it can only mean one thing─more morbols. The realm does not need any more morbols.

entries.name: Standing Guard
entries.description: Garlean engineers are constantly at work modifying and improving the design of their machina. A new make of vanguard, the H-3, has recently been deployed into the field for testing. Destroy them and stall the march of imperial progress.

entries.name: Another Notch on the Torch
entries.description: Gorer of a thousand guts, Porus of the redhorns has taken refuge in the Singing Shards after being pursued halfway across Coerthas by a band of bounty hunters─the bounty hunters his 997th, 998th, 999th, and 1000th victims. See that you aren't his 1001st.

entries.name: One Giant Leap
entries.description: It has recently been discovered in ancient Sharlayan documents that the gigas believe the Crystal Tower a holy place, and that is the reason why the colossal beings have begun gathering in north Silvertear. This, unfortunately, has made it difficult for the Sons of Saint Coinach to conduct their research, what with the gigas constantly destroying their findings.

entries.name: Among Giants
entries.description: Driven south by the cold weather and lack of prey, many gigas have taken a foothold on the northern shore of Silvertear Lake, much to the chagrin of the Sons of Saint Coinach who are currently in the area studying the ancient ruins and crystalline phenomena. The Sons seek assistance in driving the colossi from the area.

entries.name: Another Day, Another Demon
entries.description: Most only simple naturalists─their wits the sharpest weapon in their packs─the Sons of Saint Coinach are finding it difficult to carry out their research when it seems like every day they are being hunted by some pack of mythical wild beasts. Today's excitement─a flock of hungry hippogryphs.

entries.name: That's What Adventurers Are For
entries.description: The Sons of Saint Coinach find themselves in a bind once again, this time thanks to one Dione─a gigas high priest rumored to be older than time itself. The naturalists won't sleep easy until this menace is resting at the bottom of Silvertear Lake.

entries.name: Home Is Where the Horn Is
entries.description: Hapalits, foul cousins of the ogres, are on the move in search of a new lair, far from the levinbolts of their former abode. The violent creatures have a natural tendency to tear anything moving into two, and so while one might sympathize with their plight to find a new home, it is for the best that they are not allowed to set up camp anywhere nearby.

entries.name: Gone with the Shadow
entries.description: Over the course of the past three nights, three Sons of Saint Coinach have gone missing from their tents. The guards claim they saw nothing but shadows, but perhaps therein lies the answer to this mystery. Let the dark hunt begin!

entries.name: The Prodigal Son
entries.description: One of the Sons of Saint Coinach requires an escort deep into dangerous territory so that he may continue his research on the acoustic properties of the aetherial manifestations of the area.

entries.name: V for Vinedetta
entries.description: More than one weary adventurer has wandered into the Tangle, lured by the sweet smell of a noblewoman's perfume, only to find the gaping maw of Voluptuous Vivian─a massive morbol with a taste for the flesh of man.

entries.name: Return of the King
entries.description: After a five year absence, the Bombard King has appeared in Eorzea once again (much to the delight of the Cascadiers). Don your uniforms and head into battle with the cadets, protecting the brave men and women while they attempt to dispatch the royal pain.

entries.name: Return of the King
entries.description: After a five year absence, the Bombard King has appeared in Eorzea once again (much to the delight of the Cascadiers). Don your uniforms and head into battle with the cadets, protecting the brave men and women while they attempt to dispatch the royal pain.

entries.name: Return of the King
entries.description: After a five year absence, the Bombard King has appeared in Eorzea once again (much to the delight of the Cascadiers). Don your uniforms and head into battle with the cadets, protecting the brave men and women while they attempt to dispatch the royal pain.

entries.description: After a five year absence, the Bombard King has appeared in Eorzea once again (much to the delight of the Cascadiers). Don your uniforms and head into battle with the cadets, protecting the brave men and women while they attempt to dispatch the royal pain.

entries.description: After a five year absence, the Bombard King has appeared in Eorzea once again (much to the delight of the Cascadiers). Don your uniforms and head into battle with the cadets, protecting the brave men and women while they attempt to dispatch the royal pain.
